        Required environment: BL: qualified browser preview and exported fixtures.

The product scope is E2 only. .agent-workflows/verify.md, queue-merge.md (cloud path), cloud-delegate.md "Execute and return"; and docs/plan-runs/known-traps.md in full: the traps and rules every worker in this run follows.

CARRY   E1 landed and independently passed on exact 8c9f2684bc419242f79f4d36e5f61fe7e5e41d1f, https://github.com/NoaCG/NoaCG-Studio/pull/2369#issuecomment-6785538392. Phase E2 owns only the loop scope of #774.
NOTES   none
RULES   Coordinator already provisioned the exact clean owned worktree; verify it, do not recreate it. Run worker plan preflight against C:/claude/Temp/editor-r15-state-1108/258a3a74/wave.md and the current folder rules before work. For risky loop state transitions write/push observable rules and obtain fresh independent read-only review before code. Reproduce or demonstrate missing behavior first. Use a hand-written oracle for hold, interruption, replay, finite Out, backward seek, boundaries, settling and supported speed continuity. Preserve legacy and unrelated authored source and exact interpreter ownership. Keep normal local scheduler gates and one browser job; no full suites or overrides locally. Use isolated data and no production access. Reread #1967 and run sideEnds on the final candidate paths. Keep engineering within E2 and checkpoint safely before the block boundary if needed. Only coordinator stamps, queues and owns terminal repair. No edits in other worktrees.

You own this phase like a session of your own: research or reproduce first, decide the design, build, verify, land. Decide design defaults yourself and say what and why in the PR. Ask nobody; if a real owner decision blocks part of it, finish the rest and say so.
Work in C:/claude/Temp/editor-r15-e2-build-1111 on codex/plan-editor-r1-5-e2-build from the exact 8c9f2684bc419242f79f4d36e5f61fe7e5e41d1f commit, created before any edit; fetch first, then pin that SHA. A phase that fixes an issue puts `Closes #<n>` on its own line in a commit message. A follow-up you do not fix becomes a GitHub issue with a priority, an area label and why it matters. Nothing speculative, no handoff file.
Then $check and the cloud path of $queue-merge, until the worker gates in the traps file are green on your reviewed head. The coordinator posts the review stamp, turns auto-merge on and is the PR's repair owner: stop there and report. If it messages you a CI failure or review finding later, repair it within scope, at most three attempts per failure.
Assessment A or A+ is required on your FINAL diff: a fresh read-only $so session after your last change (again if review rounds change the diff; only the traps file's Narrow delta may narrow it), with its verdict in the PR.
